body: Split-adjusted ₹7.81 (Feb 2009) → ATH ₹4,386 (Jul 2021) ≈560x; standalone P/E 8.4 → 76 (9x) × implied EPS ~62x. Final leg ₹315 (Jan 2019) → ₹4,386: 14x in 2.6 years with EPS ~3.6x (₹16.2 → ₹58.1) and P/E 18.6 → 76 (4x). Drawdowns in the run: −35% (2014–15), −29% (COVID). Early signal (narrative partly unverified): India's leading methyl/ethyl-amine maker, import-substituting Chinese supply. Visible in filings: steady capacity additions; FY21 standalone OPM 35% and ROCE 56% as amine spreads widened during Chinese environmental shutdowns and COVID pharma demand; for a decade before that it traded at P/E 5–17. Ended: spreads normalised and domestic competition added capacity; standalone EPS FY21 ₹57.9 → FY24 ₹29.1 (−50%) and revenue −14% in FY24. The stock fell −71% to ₹1,278 (Mar 2026); ₹1,573 on 19 Nov 2026 (P/E ~32), with EPS partly recovered (TTM ₹48). Lesson: a peak-spread year capitalised at 76x is a classic cyclical top. For chemicals, ask what EPS looks like at mid-cycle spreads before paying a quality multiple.

data.early_signals: import substitution; capacity adds; P/E 5-17 for a decade
data.note: Prices: screener.in weekly closes, split/bonus-adjusted. P/E = trailing (TTM); implied EPS x = price multiple / P/E multiple.

title: Alkyl Amines 2009–2021: specialty amines ~560x, then −71% as spreads fell
